cases.description: Vision grader. The image (fixtures/handwritten-derivative.png, a real phone photo of handwriting, no name) shows the derivative of f(x) = (3x² − 5)⁴: u = 3x² − 5, u' = 6x; f'(x) = 4u³ · u'; f'(x) = 4(3x² − 5)³ · 6x; f'(x) = 18x(3x² − 5)³. Ground truth: chain rule and intermediate steps are correct; the last line has one arithmetic slip (4 · 6 = 24, so the correct answer is 24x(3x² − 5)³, not 18x). Expected draft score about 8/10 (chain rule 4, steps 3, final answer 0, notation 1). The output must name this slip concretely and must not invent other errors or steps.
